title: Mønsted's Open Landscapes
content: Peder Mork Mønsted is best known for his scenes of forest streams, so it's interesting to see what he does with open fields.Heather Covered Hillsby Peder Mork Mønsted contrasts the greens with the reddish tinge of the heather.A view of Borresö from Himmelbjerget, Denmark, 1912by Peder Mork Mønsted.Below are some larger scans of the images.
